personal.name: Nadia Sultana
personal.title: Human-Centered AI Researcher & UX Engineer
personal.about: I am a UX Engineer and researcher passionate about Explainable AI, Human-Computer Interaction, and biomedical machine learning. My work focuses on bridging the gap between interpretable deep learning models and scalable, user-centered system design. I enjoy building human-centered technology that makes AI more understandable and accessible, and I am eager to advance this intersection of engineering and research through industry collaborations and a PhD.
personal.mission: Building scalable, human-centered technology driven by state-of-the-art explainable AI.
